title: shadcn-port upstream exceptions
description: Per-component allowlist of deviations between the upstream shadcn/ui class strings and this project's Twig port, consumed by check-upstream-classes.mjs.

from.description: The upstream token this exception matches, or "*" to exempt the whole component from the gate.

to.description: The Twig-side replacement token, or null when the upstream token is intentionally dropped (not required in the Twig port).

source.description: "figma": deviation motivated by the Figma kit measurements. "port": deviation forced by the platform (no React/Radix).

node.description: Figma node id backing this exception (source: "figma" only).

composition.description: Marks the WHOLE component as a composition: a demo the shadcn registry ships only as an example (no `/r/styles/<style>/<name>.json` registry item to diff against), borrowing every class from the components it embeds. When present, check-upstream-classes.mjs prints '○ <name>: composition' and skips the component without fetching upstream — no `from`/`to`/`source` needed on this entry, only `composition` and `note`.
